steps.content: Complete work on the current page

workspace.title: Workspace: handle current work
workspace.overview: Review business summaries and pending work to decide what needs attention today.
workspace.navigation: Open the workspace pages granted to your account for summaries, tasks and collaboration.
workspace.content: Check the scope of the figures and task status before opening the relevant work. Detailed customer, outreach and configuration tools live in their respective modules.

customer.title: Customers and sales: from leads to customer management
customer.overview: Manage leads, customer master data and sales follow-up with traceable customer identities and progress.
customer.navigation: Start with lead discovery and rules, then move to customer records, profiles and sales follow-up. Available entries follow your account permissions.
customer.content: Filter and maintain records before opening details or following up. Customer and lead rule pages offer permitted governance tools; check the affected records before merging, assigning or archiving.

aiAgent.title: Agents and service: configure support and handle conversations
aiAgent.overview: Connect agent configuration with customer service, conversation handling and quality improvements.
aiAgent.navigation: Use the sidebar for agent configuration, service conversations and quality management. Configure services and knowledge before handling conversations and human handoffs.
aiAgent.content: Confirm the service audience and settings before testing, saving or acting on a conversation. Review outcomes with approvals and issue records.

reach.title: Outreach operations: organize channels and delivery
reach.overview: Manage channel accounts, outreach content and task execution alongside customer groups and campaign feedback.
reach.navigation: Choose an authorized channel, configure its account and connection, then prepare drafts, create tasks and review execution records.
reach.content: Check recipients, account and content before starting a task. Email sender accounts configure the actual sending identity; the email provider reference supplies connection parameters and authorization guidance.

knowledge.title: Knowledge center: maintain useful business knowledge
knowledge.overview: Import and maintain business knowledge to provide traceable sources for agent retrieval and answers.
knowledge.navigation: Use the sidebar for import, management, retrieval checks and feedback. Tokens and API entries connect business systems.
knowledge.content: Check sources and import results, then test retrieval matches and answer evidence. Revise content using feedback and review statistics.

geoTools.title: GEO growth: produce, publish and verify
geoTools.overview: Improve brand content and website discoverability through content production, publishing, monitoring and foundational configuration.
geoTools.navigation: The sidebar follows production → publishing → monitoring → configuration: prepare keywords and content, publish to sites or channels, observe results, then maintain brand, site and connection details.
geoTools.content: UA probe records show active requests made by this system with AI User-Agent headers; they do not prove actual external crawler visits. Source gap tasks track missing coverage, while brand and site configuration maintains foundational data.

analytics.title: Analytics: review business outcomes
analytics.overview: Use business metrics, funnels and trends to identify issues and inform operational and sales actions.
analytics.navigation: Choose an analysis topic in the sidebar to review metrics, conversion paths and reports for the relevant business.
analytics.content: Check the date range, filters and metric units before comparing trends or exporting results. Distinguish dashboard examples from live business data.

system.title: System management: maintain organization and settings
system.overview: Maintain accounts, permissions, connections and runtime settings to support your organization’s workflows.
system.navigation: Open the appropriate administration page. Visible entries follow server permissions; confirm the affected accounts and business scope before changing settings.
system.content: Read field guidance and current status before saving, then verify the result. Check the related business entry after changing permissions or connections.

crmList.title: Customer master data and governance tools
crmList.summary: Maintain unified customer records filtered by account, industry and owner permissions. Tools on this page appear when your account can use them.
crmList.tools: Filter customers by keyword, industry or owner first. Authorized tools include deduplication and merging, import and export, contacts, suppliers, service providers and companies. Choose the tool for your current work.
crmList.records: Check identity, source and owner before editing or opening a 360 profile. Confirm the affected records before merging customers or editing owners.

leadsRules.title: Lead rules and governance workflow
leadsRules.summary: Rules match in account → channel priority; no rule at either level means no discovery. Define scope and keywords before creating or editing a rule; lead discovery agents execute discovery tasks.
leadsRules.records: Check each rule’s scope and enabled status. Use permitted notification routes, evidence, archive and scoped lead lists to manage delivery destinations, trace sources, review history and select leads for follow-up.
